title: Crispy Pork Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe that serves a crowd with flavorful crispy pork.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and stir-fry until they begin to soften.
3. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
4. Add the sliced pork and cook until browned and crispy.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and oyster sauce (if using).
6. Add the marinade to the wok or skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
8. Serve immediately and garnish with green onions (optional).
